args.description: fast run cycle to the right: leaning far forward, a white and gold sword with white ribbons held low and trailing behind him in one hand, long fast strides, a seamless loop that ends exactly on the first pose. The whole weapon stays inside the picture. The character stays at the same place in the frame (the game moves him), always facing right, seen from the side; keep his look, proportions and colours exactly. Only the character is drawn, with what he holds: no effect, no motion streak, no speed lines, no trail behind the limbs or the weapon, no glow, no energy, no projectile, no smoke, no dust, no ground, the whole body inside the picture. Every frame shows the arms, legs and weapon clearly in a crisp pose, never blurred.
args.subject_description: a young man with messy white hair and blue eyes, a long white coat with grey tails, a black shirt, black trousers and grey boots, holding a white and gold sword with white ribbons
args.initial_pose: running to the right, leaning forward, arms swept back
